title: J4 — One family, one phone, a history abroad
description: The family's records go on one shared phone as Verified Health Links (J4.0), and a year later a doctor back in Thailand reads the whole history from Lao PDR (J4.1). One chapter of the walkthrough, two BPMN processes, so two sub-journeys.
